option_relations.rationale: High-degree AV block is a general term and does not specifically match the detailed description of Mobitz Type II with prolonged His-ventricular interval.
The vignette describes a prolonged His-ventricular interval, which is characteristic of Mobitz Type II, not Mobitz Type I (Wenckebach) in the His-Purkinje system.
Mobitz Type II Second-Degree Atrioventricular (AV) Block, with prolonged His-ventricular interval, is a specific type of bradyarrhythmia caused by conduction system disease.
Mobitz Type II Second-Degree Atrioventricular (AV) Block, with prolonged His-ventricular interval, represents a form of progressive cardiac conduction disease.
